verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents non-interactive control through a REST API, a JavaScript SDK and an official `pspace` CLI, all authenticated with API keys. Machines can be created through the API or CLI rather than the console, and Workflows automate GPU-backed ML pipelines in code. Together these cover headless, scriptable operation. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs (e.g. CI-runner examples or a non-interactive auth guide), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
